units.name: Hydra
units.pointsNote: Base cost: 365 Points (provisional). Reassess after testing degraded damage output and Fire suppression.
units.wardNote: Ward — (none printed in the base profile).

abilities.name: Five Heads
abilities.effect: Begin at W15 with five functioning heads. Each 3 remaining Wounds, rounded up, corresponds to one head; each functioning head contributes 2 Attack dice to Many-Headed Bites. Restore Attack dice when healing crosses a head threshold.

abilities.name: Many Heads
abilities.effect: Divide the available Bite dice among up to three enemy Units in Engaged 2" range, declaring allocations before rolling. Roll each target's dice as a separate Attack pool with its own Surges, Critical conversions and Saves. This still uses one Combat activation.

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.effect: At the start of each Round, Heal 1. Regrowth is suppressed if the Hydra suffered unsaved Fire Damage since its previous activation. Healing may restore Bite Attacks by restoring a functioning head.

abilities.name: Impact 1
abilities.effect: Add one automatic Impact Hit to the normal highest Charge die.

upgrades.name: Additional Head
upgrades.effect: +3 maximum Wounds and one more functional head (up to +2 Bite Attacks); revise head thresholds accordingly

upgrades.name: Venomous Heads
upgrades.effect: When a Bite Attack Surges, replace one successful Hit with Direct Damage 2 (Ward applies)

upgrades.name: Accelerated Regrowth
upgrades.effect: Regrowth heals 2 instead of 1 when it triggers

preconfiguredVariant.note: Printed as a fully-worked-out stat line (425 Points) in the source, consistent with the Standard profile + Elder Wurm upgrade (+65) applied on top of Standard Cave Wurm's base 360: 360 + 65 = 425. Consistent, no issue.

units.name: Abyssal Kraken

abilities.name: Four-Model Unit — Special Coherency
abilities.effect: The Kraken consists of one Body Model (W10) and three Tentacle Models (W2 each). All share the printed Armor, Evade and Ward. A Tentacle may be positioned and move independently within 6" (Short Range) of the Body, instead of the usual 3" Coherency rule. Every Model remains part of one Unit: it receives one Movement, one Assault and one eligible Combat activation, not one activation per Model.

abilities.name: Many Tentacles
abilities.effect: Each surviving Tentacle contributes its own Engaged 3" / A2 / Hit 4+ / Dmg 2 / Anti-Armored 2 attack, targeting enemies it can reach. Separate target pools if Tentacles attack different eligible Units. The Body uses Abyssal Jet (10" / A4 / 5+ / 2 / Anti-Infantry 2), as its eligible ranged Assault profile.

abilities.name: Damage allocation — Exception
abilities.effect: Attacks that can reach only a Tentacle allocate Hits and Damage among the eligible Tentacles, not to the distant Body. Attacks targeting the Body allocate to the Body.

abilities.name: Aquatic
abilities.effect: Ignore swimming penalties; on land, the Unit's Move is M2".

abilities.name: Grasping Limbs
abilities.effect: After a Tentacle Attack inflicts unsaved Damage, its target suffers Slow 1.

abilities.name: Ink Cloud
abilities.effect: When targeted by a non-Instant ranged Attack while in water, become Concealed until the end of the Phase; use normal Reaction timing.

abilities.name: Grasping Tentacles
abilities.effect: After one of this Unit's Tentacle Attacks deals Damage, reposition one non-Hero target Model up to 2" within legal placement. The target Unit must still maintain Coherency. This is forced movement and does not grant an extra Attack.

upgrades.name: Elder Kraken
upgrades.effect: Increase Body Wounds to 14 (total Unit Wounds 20)

notes: The Kraken has no printed Impact bonus; like any ordinary eligible Unit it still generates the normal highest-die Impact on a successful Charge. Tentacles do not each generate separate Impact pools.

knownIssues: Hydra's base model profile prints 'Ward —' (no Ward) in the Profiles table, unlike most other Large Monsters of comparable Elite status which have a Magic Ward (e.g. Young Dragon Ward 6+ Magic). This is likely intentional (balancing its very high Wounds/Attack ceiling) rather than an omission, but is flagged here since it's an outlier within the section.
